description: Data governance and stewardship workflow for a CPaaS email API, covering classification, policy definition, consent management, compliance checks, retention, and audit.

email_template_id.description: Unique identifier for an email template definition.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier for a data governance policy.

consent_profile_id.description: Unique identifier for a recipient's consent profile.

governance_rule_set_id.description: Identifier for a combined set of policies and rules applied to a sending context.

compliance_check_id.description: Identifier for a specific pre-send compliance check execution.

retention_job_id.description: Identifier for a data retention or deletion job.

email_campaign_id.description: Identifier for a logical email sending campaign or program.

governance_violation_id.description: Identifier for a logged governance violation event.

data_export_request_id.description: Identifier for a subject data export request.

functions.name: classify_email_template
functions.description: Classify an email template for sensitivity, data categories, and regulatory requirements.

content_snapshot.description: Optional snapshot of the template content, used if the classifier cannot fetch it.

html_body.description: HTML content of the email body.

text_body.description: Plain text content of the email body.

placeholders.description: Dynamic placeholders used in the template and the semantic data they represent.

data_category.description: Primary data category for this placeholder.

business_unit.description: Business unit or product line that owns this template.

processing_purposes.description: Purposes for which data is processed in this email.

functions.returns: Classification record including sensitivity level, detected data categories, applicable regulations, and recommended governance_rule_set_id.

functions.name: define_governance_policy
functions.description: Define or update a data governance policy for email processing, including scope, rules, and enforcement actions.

policy_id.description: Existing policy to update. Omit to create a new policy.

description.description: Detailed description of the policy intent.

owner.description: Business or technical owner of this policy.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value tags for grouping and search.

scope.description: Scope defining where this policy applies.

regions.description: Regions or jurisdictions this policy applies to.

regulations.description: Regulatory frameworks covered by this policy.

data_categories.description: Data categories governed by this policy.

template_filters.description: Filters to apply policy to specific templates or campaigns.

classification_levels.description: Sensitivity levels to which this policy applies.

rules.description: Set of rules that make up the policy.

rule_id.description: Optional stable identifier for this rule within the policy.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the rule triggers.

actions.description: Actions to apply when rule conditions are met.

effective_from.description: ISO timestamp when this policy becomes effective.

effective_until.description: Optional ISO timestamp when this policy expires.

functions.returns: Policy record with policy_id, version, and computed governance_rule_set_id references.

functions.name: create_governance_rule_set
functions.description: Create a governance rule set that aggregates multiple policies and template classifications for application at send time.

name.description: Human-readable name of this rule set.

description.description: Description of how and where this rule set should be applied.

policy_ids.description: List of policies that are part of this governance rule set.

default_applicability.description: Defines default apply logic when conditions overlap.

priorities.description: Ordered list of policy_ids by descending priority, used when strategy is priority_based.

bindings.description: Bindings connecting this rule set to templates, campaigns, or tenants.

target_id.description: ID of the bound entity, or tenant identifier when binding_type is tenant_default.

enabled.description: Whether the rule set is enabled for this binding.

functions.returns: Governance rule set descriptor including governance_rule_set_id and resolved active policies.

functions.name: upsert_consent_profile
functions.description: Create or update a recipient's consent profile for various email purposes and channels.

consent_profile_id.description: Existing consent profile to update. Omit to create a new profile.

recipient.description: Identity attributes of the data subject.

email.description: Primary email address of the recipient.

external_id.description: External or customer ID used by caller.

region.description: Region or country code of the data subject.

consents.description: List of consent statements and their current status.

purpose.description: Purpose for which consent is captured.

source.description: Details of how consent was collected.

evidence_url.description: URL to a record of consent capture (e.g., signed form, recording).

preferences.description: Non-legal preferences such as frequency or topics.

audit_context.description: Context of the upsert operation for audit logging.

functions.returns: Updated consent profile with consent_profile_id and normalized consent states.

functions.name: check_email_compliance
functions.description: Perform a pre-send governance and compliance check for an email send, using governance_rule_set, policies, and consent.

email_campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier for associating compliance results.

governance_rule_set_id.description: Specific rule set to apply. If omitted, system resolves one based on bindings and defaults.

recipients.description: List of intended recipients for this send batch.

consent_profile_id.description: Existing consent profile id. Either this or email is required.

email.description: Email address of the recipient if consent_profile_id not provided.

target_purposes.description: Purposes invoked for this send for this recipient.

content_features.description: Structural features of the email content relevant to compliance.

data_categories_in_payload.description: Data categories expected to be present in dynamic content.

dry_run.description: If true, do not persist compliance_check_id; evaluate only.

functions.returns: Compliance decision including compliance_check_id, per-recipient allow/deny with reasons, and policy actions to enforce (e.g., block, mask, route).

functions.name: resolve_compliance_violations
functions.description: Resolve or override compliance violations detected during a check by applying mitigations or documented exceptions.

compliance_check_id.description: Compliance check whose violations are being resolved.

targets.description: Entities targeted for resolution based on scope.

mitigations.description: Mitigation steps applied to address or accept violations.

exception_ticket_id.description: External reference to approval or exception tracking system.

approver.description: Person or system authorizing the resolution.

functions.returns: Updated compliance check status, list of resolved and unresolved violations, and any generated governance_violation_id records for exceptions.

functions.name: enforce_policy_on_send_request
functions.description: Apply governance decisions to an email send request, possibly modifying or rejecting the request.

governance_rule_set_id.description: Rule set to enforce. If absent, resolve from template and tenant defaults.

email_template_id.description: Template that will be used for the send.

data.description: Arbitrary JSON object of personalization data.

compliance_check_id.description: Optional precomputed compliance check to reuse; if not provided, a fresh check may be run internally.

dry_run.description: If true, returns what would be enforced without mutating actual send state.

functions.returns: Enforcement result including modified send_request, filtered recipients, applied actions, and final allow/block decision.

functions.name: schedule_retention_job
functions.description: Schedule a data retention or deletion job for email logs, content, or consent records in accordance with policy.

scope.description: Defines which records are in scope for the job.

older_than_days.description: Include data older than this number of days.

policy_id.description: Policy driving this retention job, if applicable.

run_at.description: Exact time for a one-time job.

safety_guardrails.description: Guardrails to prevent accidental large deletions.

requested_by.description: Identifier of the user or system scheduling the job.

functions.returns: Retention job descriptor with retention_job_id, initial status, and estimated affected records.

functions.name: get_retention_job_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and results of a retention or deletion job.

include.description: Additional information to include in the response.

functions.returns: Retention job status including completion state, counts of processed and deleted records, and any errors.

functions.name: log_governance_violation
functions.description: Log a governance violation event such as unauthorized send, policy breach, or failed retention.

detected_by.description: System or user that detected the violation.

reference.description: URI or identifier of the evidence.

functions.returns: Logged violation record including governance_violation_id and initial remediation status.

functions.name: review_governance_violation
functions.description: Review and update the state of a logged governance violation, including remediation steps and closure.

governance_violation_id.description: Identifier of the violation to review.

functions.returns: Updated governance violation record with new status and remediation timeline.

functions.name: export_subject_data
functions.description: Create a data export request for a data subject, covering email events, consent, and profile data.

email.description: Primary email identifier of the subject.

data_categories.description: Categories of data to include in the export.

delivery.description: Delivery options for the exported data.

target.description: Email address, SFTP path, or similar target.

requested_by.description: Identifier of the requestor (data subject, admin, etc.).

functions.returns: Data export request record including data_export_request_id, initial processing state, and expected completion time.

functions.name: get_subject_data_export_status
functions.description: Get the status and result location of a subject data export request.

data_export_request_id.description: Identifier of the data export request.

functions.returns: Export status including completion state, download URL or delivery confirmation, and any failure reasons.

functions.name: rollback_governance_decision
functions.description: Rollback or retry governance-related decisions, such as misapplied retention or policy enforcement errors.

target_id.description: Identifier of the entity to rollback, such as retention_job_id, policy_id, consent_profile_id, or compliance_check_id.

retry_parameters.description: Override parameters when strategy is retry_with_fix.

requested_by.description: Identifier of the user or system requesting rollback.

approval.description: Optional approval metadata required for some rollback operations.

functions.returns: Rollback operation result including whether rollback or retry was scheduled or completed, and any new retention_job_id or compliance_check_id created.

functions.name: bulk_import_governance_rule_sets
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple governance_rule_sets from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined governance_rule_sets, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_governance_rule_sets
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of governance_rule_sets matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped governance_rule_sets with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_governance_rule_sets
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of governance_rule_sets with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_governance_rule_sets
functions.description: Export a filtered set of governance_rule_sets to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_governance_rule_sets_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across governance_rule_sets with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with governance_rule_sets hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_governance_rule_set_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on governance_rule_set lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_governance_rule_set_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing governance_rule_set subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_governance_rule_set_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a governance_rule_set subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_governance_rule_set_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single governance_rule_set with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across governance_rule_sets for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_governance_rule_set_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of governance_rule_sets.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_governance_rule_set_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to governance_rule_sets with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of governance_rule_set jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_governance_rule_set_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight governance_rule_set job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_governance_rule_set_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a governance_rule_set (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_governance_rule_set_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive governance_rule_set change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_governance_rule_set_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a governance_rule_set approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_governance_rule_set_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a governance_rule_set, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_governance_rule_set_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a governance_rule_set, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_governance_rule_set
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a governance_rule_set for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_governance_rule_set_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a governance_rule_set from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_governance_rule_set_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over governance_rule_sets (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched governance_rule_sets.

functions.name: build_governance_rule_set_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over governance_rule_sets data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_governance_rule_set_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern governance_rule_set behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_governance_rule_set_policies
functions.description: List policies governing governance_rule_sets with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.
